text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain is installed and verified. Here's the report.

## What was installed

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Bun 1.4.4 (at the gbrain floor) in `~/.bun/bin` |
| gbrain | **0.60.734.0**, installed where the docs say `#stable`: `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0` (resolved to commit `a278ddf`) |
| Brain | Keyless PGLite at `/harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite`, schema v318, `gbrain doctor` = **healthy, 100** |
| Provider keys | None configured — nothing paid can run; keyword retrieval only, embeddings off |

**Identity preserved:** your workspace had no `AGENTS.md`/`SOUL.md` to begin with, so nothing was replaced. I did *not* run the soul-audit/bootstrap interview. The only instruction file added is GBrain's managed brain-first block in `/workspace/AGENTS.md`, fenced by `<!-- gbrain:brain-first:begin/end -->` so you can edit around it or remove it with `gbrain setup openclaw --instructions-only --no-instructions`.

## Wiring into this agent

- MCP server `gbrain` registered stdio (`serve --surface starter --advertise verbs`, `GBRAIN_HOME=/harness-state`), probe reports **8 tools** (`remember`, `recall`, `entity`, `search`, `query`, `get_page`, `forget`, `request_tools`…), `openclaw mcp doctor gbrain` = ok.
- Per-turn brain-first rule plugin `gbrain-turn-rule` installed and **activated** (it fires beside each user turn — the OpenClaw route the docs prefer, since a listed skill gets followed only 1–3% of the time).
- Ran `openclaw mcp reload` so the tools land on your **next turn** without restarting the gateway. I did not restart the gateway mid-conversation.

## Round trip verified with real calls

- **CLI (separate processes):** `remember` → fact #1 `inserted`, then `recall --grep` in a new process returned it (proves local persistence). Fact #1 was then `forget`-ten as the docs' install-check cleanup.
- **MCP protocol (the path the agent will use):** `initialize` → `tools/list` → `tools/call remember` → fact #2 `inserted` (entity `gbrain-mcp-check`, provenance `install-check`) → `tools/call recall` returned the fact with its provenance and `origin: mcp:remember`.
- Fact #2 is deliberately left in place as the marker to re-`recall` after your next turn/session; run `gbrain forget 2` once you've seen it come back.

## Search mode — your choice

Currently **conservative** (auto-applied: no chat key and no reranker, so a tight 4K budget was the only honest default).

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

1. **conservative** — 4K budget, 10 chunks, no reranker. In effect now; best while keyless.
2. **balanced** — 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked (needs a reranker key to actually rerank).
3. **tokenmax** — no budget, 50 chunks, reranked. Recommended once you add a chat key.

I can't switch it mid-answer without your pick — say the word and I'll run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>` and confirm with `gbrain search modes`.

## Other first-run settings in effect

- **Writeback: off** — I save only what you explicitly ask. `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient` turns on durable-fact saving with provenance (recommended for a personal brain).
- **Upkeep: on** — free, runs while the gbrain session is open. Off: `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive: on** — one redacted page per conversation per day, local only while keyless. Off: `gbrain transcripts archive off`.

## Notes

- Skip-listed as the docs instruct: no daemon, cron, autopilot, connectors, or paid enrichment. The v0.53.0 shared-skills migration left a host-publication step pending (no grants changed); harmless for memory-only use.
- I did not scaffold the five bundled skills into the workspace — OpenClaw shows every workspace skill in every prompt, so they cost tokens each turn, and the turn rule already covers brain-first. Happy to add them if you want.
- OpenClaw's config writer rewrote `openclaw.json` as plain JSON, dropping its existing JSON5 comments (values unchanged).
- Worth knowing: hosted GBrain at gbrain.io is the alternative if you'd rather not keep this brain online — but this one is local and yours.
